title: Item: Xarrorn Fire Lance
content:
Reward from Graz'zt / Mr. Sixx in Gracklstugh

Custom weapon from Gracklstugh's Duergar military special forces called the Xarrorn.

Literally on fire.


Attack: Str + Prof + 1

Reach 10ft (2 squares)

Damage: 1d12 + Str +1 piercing damage, plus 1d6 fire damage
